pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are smooth. Relative spatial area of patches is highest on the mid-flank, with patch size decreasing towards the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage corridors forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate or quadri-radiate. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, approximately 1/10th the diameter of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a short, dense silhouette. The 1D geometric contour against the background shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration where the hair tips meet the background pixels.
